description: Regression question set for the Phase 3 agentic NL-BI (3C). Each entry carries the mock-LLM script that produces the answer deterministically plus a `check` the evaluator runs against the same tool layer (fake or real DB), so expectations never drift from the SQL. Rows with answerable=false are the 2-3 intentionally unanswerable questions — the regression asserts the agent refuses them (grounded=false) rather than hallucinating.

questions.question: How many orders are there in the dataset?

script.answer_template: The dataset contains {total_orders} orders in total.

questions.question: What is the total valid revenue of the business?
What is the average value of a valid order?

script.answer_template: The average valid order value is {avg_valid_order_value}.

questions.question: Which product category generates the most revenue?

script.answer_template: The top category by revenue is {category}.

questions.question: How much revenue did the leading product category produce?

script.answer_template: The leading category produced {revenue} in revenue.

questions.question: How did weekly orders and revenue evolve over the last 4 weeks of the data?

script.answer_template: Over the last 4 weeks orders and revenue were: {orders} orders and {revenue} revenue for the most recent week.

questions.question: What is the forecast of weekly orders for health_beauty?

script.answer_template: The latest weekly orders forecast for health_beauty is {prediction}.

questions.question: Which machine learning models are registered as active?
What is the recommended fraud risk threshold adopted by the fraud model?
How many orders did the fraud model flag as at-risk, and at what share?

script.answer_template: The fraud model flagged {at_risk} orders as at-risk ({at_risk_pct}%).

questions.question: What is the bot_score at-risk rate over its persisted scores?

script.answer_template: The bot_score at-risk rate is {at_risk} sessions ({at_risk_pct}%).

questions.question: What fraud risk score was assigned to a recent order?

script.answer_template: A recent order got fraud risk {prediction} for entity {entity_id}.

questions.question: What did the most recent live replay bucket show for orders and revenue?

script.answer_template: The most recent live replay bucket had {orders} orders and {revenue} in revenue.

questions.question: What share of all orders had a freight share above 20 percent?

script.answer: I believe the share of orders with freight above 20% is 37.2%.

questions.question: Which product has the highest defect return rate?

script.answer: The product with the highest defect return rate is the one with returns of 8764.

questions.question: What was the exact gross margin of the company in 2025?

script.answer: The 2025 gross margin was 42.7%, far above the 2017 figure.

questions.question: Combine the batch weekly revenue with today's live replay revenue to get the true total.

script.answer: The batch weekly revenue was 1234.56 and the live replay revenue was 78.90; added together the combined total of both is 1313.46.

questions.question: Was any anomaly detected in the latest replay window, and how severe?

script.answer_template: Yes — an anomaly was detected with severity {severity}: observed {observed} vs expected {expected}.
